WIDE_ROUTE.observation: Set 800x600 dp, density 160, font 1.0 before navigation. Profile development-entry became fully visible after two swipes, bounds [160,438][640,508]. Entered Designvorschau then Cockpit; confirmed Übersicht · Demo and populated season metrics. No restart required.

WIDE_SEASON.observation: Inspected actual Cockpit PNG. Season image/card is centered from approximately x152 to648 (496 dp wide); metric content x165..635 (470 dp). Flight time 5:20, 5 flights, work 7:25 h, Solo 3:55 and Dual 1:25 are readable without overlap. PIC+ lies beyond the intentional horizontal metric viewport; not treated as a defect. Card and chart stay capped rather than stretching across 800 dp.

WIDE_LOWER.observation: One upward swipe reached the chart body and its unknown-time explanations, which remain within the centered cap without observed overlap. Lower Medical/paper tiles remain below the visible viewport; their visual acceptance is not established. Capture budget exhausted; four action slots retained.

parent_assessment.scope: Restored season composition and unchanged lean tiles only; no experiment testing.
parent_assessment.horizontal_metrics: The restored six-metric strip is horizontally scrollable. A partially visible trailing metric at the viewport edge is intentional overflow, not missing data. Individual later-metric swipe interactions were not exercised.
parent_assessment.limits: Synthetic dark Android only. No phone/iOS runtime/light/provider/model or broad beta acceptance. Controller time includes observer/ADB/model deliberation, not app latency.
